## Kyoto Spring Trip Overview

A low-walking, transit-friendly 5-day plan for **2 adults** in Kyoto from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14**, staying within **180,000 JPY** excluding international flights.
Plan focus: **temples, quiet gardens, local food, and one easy day trip**, with a **station-area hotel**, **breakfast included**, and **no nightlife**.

## 5-Day Kyoto Itinerary with Budget

| Day | Plan | Transit-friendly highlights | Estimated cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 10 | Arrival + Higashiyama light day | Check-in near Kyoto Station; Kiyomizu-dera area by taxi/bus; early dinner | **28,000 JPY** |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama gardens + temples | Bamboo Grove at low-crowd time; Tenryu-ji garden; scenic train optional | **32,000 JPY** |
| Apr 12 | Central Kyoto temples + food | Nijo Castle area; Nishiki Market lunch; quiet temple stop in afternoon | **30,000 JPY** |
| Apr 13 | Easy day trip to Nara | Nara Park, Todaiji, calm garden time; return to Kyoto by late afternoon | **34,000 JPY** |
| Apr 14 | North Kyoto + departure | Kinkaku-ji or Ryoan-ji; relaxed café lunch; airport/station transfer | **26,000 JPY** |

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Plan

### Day 1: Arrival and Gentle East Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in near **Kyoto Station** or **Shijo/Gojo** for easy transit and minimal walking.
- Afternoon: Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** area using taxi plus short walks; keep the route short and skip steep detours if the knee is sore.
- Dinner: Simple local meal near the hotel, such as **yudofu**, **soba**, or a set meal with seasonal vegetables.
- Estimated cost: **28,000 JPY** including hotel, transit, entrance fees, and dinner.

### Day 2: Arashiyama Temples and Quiet Garden Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama** to avoid crowds; use the station area and short taxi rides where helpful.
- Afternoon: Visit **Tenryu-ji** for its garden, then rest at a café or riverside bench; keep the bamboo grove visit brief and flat.
- Dinner: Try **tofu cuisine** or a seasonal Kyoto kaiseki lunch-dinner set if energy is good.
- Estimated cost: **32,000 JPY** including transit, temple entries, and meals.

### Day 3: Central Kyoto Temples and Local Food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or another low-walking central landmark with easy taxi access.
- Afternoon: Explore **Nishiki Market** for lunch and snacks; keep this as a food-focused stop with short pauses.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Explore **Nishiki Market** for lunch and snacks; keep this as a food-focused stop with short pauses, Kyoto, Japan
- Dinner: Choose a calm restaurant near the hotel; avoid late dining and nightlife districts.
- Estimated cost: **30,000 JPY** including admissions, food, and transit.

### Day 4: Easy Day Trip to Nara
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take an early **JR or Kintetsu train** to **Nara**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Todaiji** and spend relaxed time in **Nara Park**; if walking becomes tiring, shorten the route and focus on one or two sights.
- Dinner: Return to Kyoto for a quiet dinner near the station.
- Estimated cost: **34,000 JPY** including round-trip transit, admissions, and meals.

### Day 5: North Kyoto and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** or **Ryoan-ji**; both work well as a final temple day with controlled pacing.
- Afternoon: Have a relaxed lunch, then head back to the hotel for luggage pickup and departure transfer.
- Dinner: Not needed unless your departure is late; if so, choose a station-area meal.
- Estimated cost: **26,000 JPY** including transit, entry, and lunch.

## Budget Fit and Hotel Target

- Planned trip total: **150,000 JPY**
- Budget ceiling: **180,000 JPY**
- Buffer remaining: **30,000 JPY**

Recommended hotel profile:
- **Near Kyoto Station, Gojo, or Shijo**
- **Breakfast included**
- **Elevator access**
- **Compact room but easy transit**
- **Quiet neighborhood, not nightlife-focused**

Likely spend split:
- Hotel for 4 nights with breakfast: **70,000–90,000 JPY**
- Food and local meals: **30,000–40,000 JPY**
- Transit and day trips: **15,000–20,000 JPY**
- Temple/admission fees: **8,000–12,000 JPY**
- Contingency: **15,000–25,000 JPY**

## Short Packing List

- Comfortable walking shoes with **good cushioning**
- Knee support sleeve or brace, if used
- Lightweight rain jacket or compact umbrella
- Layers for cool mornings and warmer afternoons
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
- Small day bag with easy-access pockets
- Any needed pain relief or mobility aids
- Cash and IC transit card, if available
- Socks that are easy to change after long days

## Quick Actions

- JR West route info: https://www.westjr.co.jp/global/en/
